newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma ranges, bonds hold, short depos up.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma ranges, bonds hold, short depos up.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was locked in the 309.85-310.20 range in early quiet dealings, short-term interbank depos were slightly higher and forex forwards were holding but for a dip in tom/next, dealers said.
"The drachma is ranging against the ecu, hovering around 310," said a senior dealer at a private bank. "The ecu/drachma has fluctuated in the 309.85/310.20 corridor in the last few days."

Interbank depos were marginally higher in very short tenors and implied drachma rates from forex forwards were trading in the 10.80-11.50 percent band with the tom/next rate being softer, dealers said.

Bonds and FRNs were holding their ground in calm trading and traders said they would be watching to see what amount of 14-day funds the central bank will drain in its regular depo tender on Wednesday.

"It is very quiet and prices are little changed," a bond dealer said. "It is very important for the success of the auction on June 17 that more liquidity is injected into the system and funding gets cheaper."
The treasury will auction its first ever 10-year fixed coupon bond and re-open bids on three-, five- and seven-year bonds on June 17.

"The cost of funding is prohibitive right now for bidding aggressively at the auction," a dealer said. "Under current rate conditions, the auction will produce high yields and this will have negative repercussions on outstanding bonds and FRNs."
Bank of Greece will stick to its 11.90 percent basic deposit facility rate for the time being, a high-level central bank official told Reuters.
The mark was quoted at 159.10/20 from Monday's 159.140 fix, the dollar at 272.45/55 drachmas from 273.670 and the ecu at 309.81/91 from 309.830 drachmas.
